name: Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry with Basmati Rice
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Wash broccoli. Separate into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Transfer to a plate.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and thinly slice onion into half rings. Peel and mince garlic. Peel and mince or grate ginger.
Thinly slice steak against the grain into strips.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add steak and stir fry until browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Coat skillet with more oil, then add onion, garlic, ginger, and crushed red pepper. Stir fry until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli and stir fry until bright green and tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Add steak, soy sauce, sesame oil, and pepper; toss to combine.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
Place rice in a bowl and top with stir fry. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
